{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, verify that the only non-numeric characters are commas (which we'll remove)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the result
print("Revenue column after cleaning:")
print(sales_df['revenue_clean'].describe())

# Confirm no NaNs were introduced
print("\nAny NaNs after conversion?", sales_df['revenue_clean'].isnull().any())

# Now compute total revenue by channel
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
channel_revenue = channel_revenue.sort_values('revenue_clean', ascending=False)

print("\nTotal revenue by channel:")
print(channel_revenue)

# Identify the channel with the highest revenue
top_channel = channel_revenue.iloc[0]['channel']
max_revenue = channel_revenue.iloc[0]['revenue_clean']

print(f"\nChannel with highest total revenue: {top_channel} ($ {max_revenue:,.2f})")"}
